title: Inertial motion of incompressible continua
summary: We study the inertial motion of incompressible continua within a geometric and variational framework, extending the classical Arnold-Ebin-Marsden theory from the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of a fixed domain to configuration spaces of deformations with variable image. In the latter case, the lack of a group structure requires proving some results that are instead immediate in the classical setting.
